description: This file defines the SourceMapGenerator class responsible for generating source maps for compiled code, primarily in the context of SCSS/LESS compilation. It includes methods for adding mappings, generating JSON output, and handling filename normalization.

classes.name: SourceMapGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for creating and encoding source maps for JavaScript or CSS generated from preprocessed source files.

methods.name: addMapping
methods.description: Adds a mapping between generated code position and original source position.

methods.name: saveMap
methods.description: Saves the generated source map to a specified file. Deprecated. Throws exceptions if directory doesn't exist or if saving fails.

methods.name: generateJson
methods.description: Generates the JSON representation of the source map, including source files, mappings, and optional source contents.

methods.name: getSourcesContent
methods.description: Retrieves the contents of source files if outputSourceFiles option is enabled.

methods.name: generateMappings
methods.description: Creates the VLQ-encoded mappings string from the added mappings.

methods.name: findFileIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a source filename within the sources array.

methods.name: normalizeFilename
methods.description: Normalizes file paths for source map output, handling Windows paths and base paths.

methods.name: fixWindowsPath
methods.description: Converts Windows backslash paths to forward slash paths, optionally adding a trailing slash.
